earlier_snapshot_evidence.interpretation: Kernel reported an eight-CPU mcache configuration; this line alone is not per-core startup evidence.

limits: A78AE is a development surrogate for the handset Cortex-A78; no exact CPU identity claim.
The 8 GiB contiguous RAM map, PL011 console and QEMU PSCI are development arrangements, not verified physical handset behavior.
XNU retains SWEET/iPhone platform identities and a 1080 x 2400 RAM framebuffer; Moto UFS, panel, touch, PMIC, radios and secure firmware are not modeled.
Each XNU framebuffer capture is a circular snapshot; no visible panic in it does not prove no earlier or later panic, complete boot logs or ongoing health.
The cpus=8 XNU capture reaches test PID 1; separate core diagnostics establish modeled eight-core startup, while the retained XNU snapshots do not prove every XNU secondary initialization handshake.
No iOS graphical userland, Moto firmware chain or physical phone boot is tested in this report.
